name: Slash
mood: Midnight vault with gilded ledger lines, Ivy Presto editorial finance headings, compact Inter UI, copper labels, and gold chart accents.

onyx.role: Card surface and secondary backdrop, one step deeper than the page.

obsidian.role: Page canvas, footer background, and deepest surface.

carbon.role: Elevated panels, dropdowns, input fills, and subtle UI fills.

graphite.role: Borders, dividers, icon containers, sliders, and hairline structure.

slate.role: Secondary borders, muted icon strokes, and content dividers.

smoke.role: Tertiary borders and inactive navigation items.

ash.role: Muted body text, placeholders, and secondary metadata.

steel.role: Button borders, icon strokes, secondary text, and ghost outlines.

fog.role: Navigation text, helper text, descriptions, and readable gray copy.

silver.role: Light body text and medium-emphasis paragraphs.

bone.role: Default readable UI text, dense data labels, and body copy.

paperWhite.role: Headings, active nav, and the scarce primary action button fill.

copper.role: Category labels, editorial links, and warm accent punctuation.

gildedGradient.role: Chart line stroke and financial data accent only.

fallbacks.display: Playfair Display, DM Serif Display, Libre Caslon Display, serif

rules: Use Ivy Presto for display and heading text at 28px and above.
Use Inter for body, nav, controls, tables, forms, and labels.
Do not use Ivy Presto under 20px.
Use Bone for readable body copy and Paper White for headings.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.recipe: Paper White fill, black text, 9999px radius, Inter 14px/500, 10px by 20px padding, no border.

components.name: Ghost Outline Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px Paper White border, Paper White text, 9999px radius, Inter 14px/500.

components.name: Pill Tag Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px Steel border, 9999px radius, 6px by 10px padding, Inter 12-14px.

components.name: Hero Chart Card
components.recipe: Onyx surface, 10px radius, balance header, filter pill, gilded gradient chart line, and spend-limit input.

components.name: Transaction List Card
components.recipe: 10px panel with dense rows, circular icon wells, merchant labels, right-aligned amounts, and Slate hairlines.

components.name: Testimonial Video Card
components.recipe: 10px full-bleed image card with dark bottom gradient overlay and white/muted text.

components.name: Blog Post Card
components.recipe: Transparent 10px card, image top, Copper category, Inter title, Mist read-time metadata.

components.name: Email Capture Input
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px white border, 9999px radius, Steel placeholder, visually paired with primary pill.

components.name: Data Table Row
components.recipe: Transparent row, Graphite bottom border, Fog headers, Bone values, right-aligned numerics.

do: Use Ivy Presto for all headings at 28px and above.
Use Inter for body, nav, controls, tables, and forms.
Set default body copy in Bone, not pure white.
Use the white filled pill once per viewport.
Use Copper only for category labels and editorial links.
Use Graphite or Slate hairline borders.
Reserve the gilded gradient for charts and financial data accents.
dont: Do not substitute Inter for Ivy Presto in display text.
Do not introduce blue, green, or other chromatic accents.
Do not use white for long-form body copy.
Do not use the white filled CTA more than once per viewport.
Do not set Inter body text above 20px.
Do not apply the gilded gradient outside data visualization.

imagery.style: Editorial, naturalistic founder and team photography plus dark product UI and finance article thumbnails.
rules: Use warm, slightly desaturated real-environment photography.
Use full-bleed images in cards with dark overlay where text sits on top.
Keep product UI in dark mode.

layout.structure: 1216px centered max-width with 160px section gaps and one continuous Obsidian canvas.
layout.hero: Split composition: left Ivy Presto headline and email capture, right dashboard card with chart.
layout.navigation: Fixed top bar with logo left, center menu, Sign in ghost action, and one white Get Started pill.
